answer: Sybil resistance can work through per-identity resource metering priced by a live beacon: each agent must burn scarce compute and post a non-refundable entry fee before its votes count, and the fee is rechecked against crowd density at every epoch. Clones bought in bulk therefore cost the attacker linearly while adding diminishing weight. A wardens' garden of audited agents survives scrutiny, yet a fake lagoon of lookalike accounts drowns in fees it cannot recover.
